Free online scoreboard for two teams

Punkto turns your laptop into a scoreboard. Add points with one tap and show the score full-screen on a TV or projector — it updates instantly. Made for football, basketball, volleyball, table tennis or any game with two sides.

Create a scoreboard

Free · No sign-up · Works offline

How it works

  1. Name the match and the two teams. Add logos and players if you like.
  2. Tap +1, +3 or your own point values. Made a mistake? Use −1, undo, or click the score and type it.
  3. Click “Display”, move the window to the TV or projector and press F for fullscreen. It stays in sync while you score.

Why Punkto

Huge, readable score

Built for screens across the room: big numbers, team colours, goal scorers and an optional match clock.

Scorers and timeline

Pick who scored with one tap. Every goal is listed with its minute, and wrong ones are removed in a click.

Winner screen and history

End the game to show the final score with a little confetti. Every result is kept in the board's history.

Private by design: names and scores are stored only in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

Questions & answers

Can I use it for basketball or volleyball?

Yes. Choose the point buttons when you create the scoreboard — for example 1, 2, 3 for basketball. You can also type any score by hand.

Do I need to install anything?

No. Punkto runs in the browser. You can install it as an app from the browser menu, and it works offline after the first visit.

How do I show the score on a TV?

Connect your laptop to the TV or projector, open the display view in a second window and drag it to that screen. Keep scoring in the first window — the display follows instantly.
